notes.title: Now we make the sale because my latest title was exhibited at TokyoGameShow2022
notes.content:
Last week from 15th,Sep to 18th,Sep, TokyoGameShow2022 was held, and my latest new title "Battleship Godios" was selected for indie-game-booth. So then we make a thanks sale now !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28777693/682f99bc82b810e3c7dc8c8540cd6ec225ed39e4.jpg[/img]

The game I exhibited at TGS2022 is not for Steam title, but it has great history between the game and TAROTICA VOO DOO ! 

Actually  "TAROTICA VOO DOO" was exhibited at TokyoGameShow2014 ( 8 years ago) as selected indie game of TGS2014, and at that time, Panic.inc visited the show and found TAROTICA. They offered me to make something new latest title for their handheld game device [url=play.date]Playdate[/url]
After so many struggled days, finally, the new title "Battleship Godios for Playdate" was able to exhibit TGS2022.

As I informed you, I planned to raise the price of the game, but as you know we are living in COVID-19 days, that prevent my creative process. That was the reason why describing additional documents for the game and additional translation of the game still have been delaying

Also I planned making a sale of TAROTICA when the time I released the next game, and as I explained, Battleship Godios is deep relation with TAROTICA, so I decided to make the sale of the game now.

Who have been waiting the sale or who know me by visiting TGS2022, I am happy if you experience TAROTICA and have fun to play it !!

Sincerely
TOG
< ^ ) ) ) ) ) ) ) <

notes.title: The price of the game will be increased
notes.content:
The price of the game will be increased after the update for 2nd edition.

The price is based on the original version for MSX at about 20 years before, it is considered for  such as a student player, I have kept its price cheaper. 
But as you suppose, for the process for the release for Steam and apply for abroad versions, it have taken so many effort and have taken time to me to accomplish them to fix, and the game is not popular million AAA game,  and its my first release for Steam, unfortunately I did not consider about pricing in anticipation of future price cut for such as SALE, then  I have not be able to enough price-down till now (current price is already price downed, but..)
also, 
I can remember that the people who knows TAROTICA well often advised me that the price is too cheaper.

I can remember my old 1980's, so many arcade video games are around. I had played them with coins everyday, played them from first, no save, but we no doubt used to played them from beginning in every time we play, and more we got a skill to play the game.  Like that, After you finish TAROTICA, let play again from beginning, then, you can find yourself as you got a skill for swinging the sword well. Try to let your friend play to see, you can also find or surprised their play than you played, quite difference, you may find the seeing is also to be entertainment.

The old 80's games influenced me and give me a motivation to make a game still now. I hope that TAROTICA also be like that for you..

notes.title: You can play the game at TokyoGameShow 2018
notes.content:
These 4 years exhibited the game at major GameShow, often people standing behind the booth looking  other's play said that  "I have no idea what's going on but it seems others play with no problem. Can you explain about the game? " But after he played always said " I got it, as just you said, the best way to know the game is just play the game". Yes! Just play is the best way to know the game ! This is my conviction got after through exhibiting all GameShow.
So If you interest the game,TAROTICA VOO DOO, just visit TokyoGameShow2018 during 20-23,Sep, go to IndieGame Area at Hall 9!

notes.title: Major Update: HELL MODE (free DLC!) has been released, plus adjustments patch to make the beginning of the game easier to play!
notes.content:
The HELL MODE (free!) DLC has just been released! This is an EXTREMELY challenging mode designed for players who have already beaten the main game. Good luck!

Check out the DLC page for more information:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/853390/TAROTICA_VOO_DOO__HELL_MODE/

- - - - - -
Additionally, adjustments have been implemented to make the beginning of the normal game easier to play. If you are someone who got stuck and gave up at the beginning of the game, please try this new version!

"I'm shaking it, but is this a door?"
"There are dolls I can turn, but I have no idea what's going on?"
"I can’t figure out how to proceed from the central room. I went underground, and now it looks like I can go up and down but I don’t know what to do….."
(Etc)

If any of the above situations seem familiar, you might be able to find the way to proceed in the updated version!

 - - - - - -
I am currently working on getting the game translated into the following languages! Let me know if you have any other requests~
- French
- Italian
- Spanish
- Thai

- - - - - -
I am also currently working on implementing Steam Trading Cards!

 - - - - - -
Also, I left the old version of the game for players who want to keep using their old save data, or for people who are modifying the game’s program (there is a new launch option to start up the old version). I am planning on eventually deleting the old version sometime in the future, but if you don’t want me to delete it or if you have any other requests related to this, please send me an e-mail!
